events.title: Dark Trip Playtest Update
events.summary: Hello investigators!Over the past few weeks, we have released several updates for the Dark Trip Playtest. All of these improvements are now included in the latest version. The biggest change is a complete redesign of the inspection system. You can now freely rotate collected items, zoom in, examine details, and switch between clues more smoothly. events.title: Dark Trip Playtest Sign-Up
events.summary: Hello everyone!We’re opening the very first playtest of Dark Trip on Steam. This is still an early version of the game, and your feedback will help us understand what works, what feels unclear, and what needs more polish. In Dark Trip, you take on the role of an investigator searching for a missing woman. You’ll explore creepy rooms, see strange things, take pills to solve puzzles, rely on hallucinations to investigate an eerie crime, and perform wicked experiments inside a mysterious laboratory
